نتساند (form VI)
# نَتَسَانَدُ (natasānadu) /na.ta.saː.na.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَانَدَ (tasānada)
# نَتَسَانَدَ (natasānada) /na.ta.saː.na.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَانَدَ (tasānada)
# نَتَسَانَدْ (natasānad) /na.ta.saː.nad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَانَدَ (tasānada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
